caption: The drawing depicts a quilt square composed of multiple cube-like shapes grouped together, with each cube divided into three diamond-shaped faces. The cubes are formed by fabrics of different colors and patterns, mainly shades of blue, off-white, beige, and gray, with some sections featuring small floral, dotted, or geometric designs. The background and the angular spaces between the cubes are filled with a deep red color, quilted with parallel lines that follow the triangular or diamond-shaped sections. The quilt edges are defined by a red border, and some of the white spaces on the cubes are decorated with delicate, subtle patterns. The entire composition is set against a plain background, and there is a small signature in the lower right that reads "Charles Goodwin, '40."
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
